title: date picker when weekday always type
rule: Date picker only when weekday / scheduling context helps. Always allow typing. Birthdays and other well-known dates use memorable date fields. Hint `mm/dd/yyyy`. Do not auto-submit on picking a day. Dual-cite GOV.UK three-field memorable date (no auto-tab) and USWDS month=select vs three text fields — both pass if labeled, no auto-advance, not `type=number`. Do not pick a house month control.
pass_when: Well-known dates are memorable fields (typed); picker is optional for scheduling and typing still works; no auto-submit; no auto-advance; day/year not `type=number`.
fail_when: Birthday-only calendar with no typing; auto-submit on pick; auto-advance; `type=number` day/year.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: A winner between month-select and three text fields.
